描述_EN: by the beginning of the 7th century large quantities of silver pieces with exotic shapes and styles were imported along the silk road from iran and central asia to china. silver objects were not as highly coveted in china as in other ancient civilisations such as the roman or the parthian, but they became important luxury items for emperors and high-ranking officials during the tang dynasty (ad 618-960). the shape of this five-lobed bowl was probably influenced by sasanian silver items and was also imitated in ceramic. chinese craftsmen often reproduced foreign shapes and acquired new manufacturing techniques from central asian silversmiths who had settled in chinese urban centres beginning in the mid 7th century.
描述_ZN: 到7世纪初，大量具有异国风格的银器沿着丝绸之路从伊朗和中亚进口到中国。 银器在中国并不像罗马或帕提亚等其他文明古国那样受到追捧，但在唐朝（公元618-960年），它们成为皇帝和高级官员的重要奢侈品。 这个五叶碗的形状可能是受到了萨桑尼亚银器的影响，在陶瓷中也被模仿。 中国的工匠们经常复制外国的形状，并从7世纪中叶开始在中国城市中心定居的中亚银匠那里获得新的制造技术。
